events.summary: Speaker B stated the group will design a new remote control.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: we're gonna design a new remote control, as you probably all know.

events.summary: Speaker B set the design process as three phases: functional, architectural and detailed design.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: We're gonna have the three kay phases, as you've probably already been told

events.summary: Speaker B set the broad overview for the remote as original, trendy and user-friendly.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: The very broad overview is original, trendy, and user-friendly.

events.summary: Speaker B proposed that originality is a very key aspect of the design so the remote stands out from many others.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: personally I think that the original is gonna be a very key aspect to this design.

events.summary: Speaker B stated the project cost is twelve point five euros per unit.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: As you can see, twelve point five Euros per unit.

events.summary: Speaker B stated the hoped-for selling price is twenty five euros per unit.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: we're hoping to sell them for twenty five.

events.summary: Speaker B stated the group is aiming for fifty million euros, which means selling a lot of units at twelve point five euros profit each.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: If we're aiming for fifty million Euros

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a niche remote with a conventional push-button design, aimed at the touch-screen LCD remote functions but at a much lower price bracket.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: it occurs to me there might be a niche for uh for a remote

events.summary: Speaker B ruled out a touch screen remote because it would probably be out of the price range the group is looking at.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: going for a touch screen would probably be possibly out of our yeah

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a remote that operates multiple units in a more integrated fashion, with at least limited ability to run macros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: something that could um operate between multiple units in a more integrated fashion.

events.summary: Speaker B proposed one on button that turns on the video recorder, the TV and maybe the sound system in one go.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: one on button would turn on say the video recorder

events.summary: Speaker A gave an example: pressing play on the DVD player also turns the TV on and onto the right channel.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: you press uh say the play button for the D_V_D_ player

events.summary: Speaker B agreed the one-button multi-device macro idea is a good strong idea.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: that sounds like a a good strong idea.

events.summary: Speaker C proposed a remote specialised for game playing or interactive television, because gaming is becoming popular with television and standard remotes wear out and are poor keypads for games.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: gaming c is becoming quite popular with television

events.summary: Speaker C proposed setting recording times by sliding a bar for start time and another for end time, instead of entering times.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: you simply stri slide a bar to say what time it begins

events.summary: Speaker C proposed big buttons for up, down, left, right and shoot for gaming, plus buttons to change camera angles for interactive television.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: you want some big buttons for up, down, left and right, shoot.

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a stick or control pad on the remote for gaming instead of buttons.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: do you think they should have some sort of stick on it, rather than buttons?

events.summary: Speaker B agreed to a small keypad or joystick-style control pad, because users are used to consoles and mobile phones.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I I don't see why not, almost everybody is probably used to a console by now

events.summary: Speaker A proposed making the remote fairly ergonomic so it fits comfortably into the hand, while allowing an unconventional or attractive shape.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: to make something you know fairly sort of ergonomic

events.summary: Speaker B summarised the design as small, stylish and a little different.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: So, small, stylish, and something that's just a little different.

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a slightly biomorphic curved form so the remote conforms to the shape of the hand.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Something sort of sort of sl slightly sort of biomorphic in form

events.summary: Speaker B committed to write up what the group quickly did and send it to everybody.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I'll write up what we've um kind of quickly done
